parameters.query:
INSERT INTO vendors (name)
VALUES ('{{ $json.vendor_name }}')
ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO invoices (
  id, 
  vendor_id, 
  sender, 
  received_date, 
  amount, 
  drive_link, 
  status,
  bank_name,
  bank_code,
  account_name,
  account_number
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Code').item.json.invoice_id }}',
  (SELECT id FROM vendors WHERE name = '{{ $('Code').item.json.vendor_name }}'),
  '{{ $('Code').item.json.SenderEmail }}',
  TO_DATE('{{ $('Code').item.json.invoice_date }}', 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
  {{ $('Code').item.json.amount }},
  '{{ $('Code').item.json.DriveLink }}',
  'Pending',
  '{{ $('Code').item.json.bank_name }}',
  '{{ $('Code').item.json.bank_code }}',
  '{{ $('Code').item.json.account_name }}',
  '{{ $('Code').item.json.account_number }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  amount = EXCLUDED.amount,
  drive_link = EXCLUDED.drive_link,
  bank_name = EXCLUDED.bank_name,
  bank_code = EXCLUDED.bank_code,
  account_name = EXCLUDED.account_name,
  account_number = EXCLUDED.account_number;
